# E118 -- KALW Radio Brand Guidelines (2021)

## Metadata
- **Brand:** KALW 91.7 FM (Public Media / Radio)
- **Year:** June 2021
- **Source PDF:** 9bb1ebd0dcac4d77f01aca9132bc9600.pdf
- **Pages:** 101
- **Produced by:** Not credited (Adobe InDesign 16.2, landscape 1920x1080 format)
- **Confidentiality:** "For internal use only. Not for distribution."

## Brand Strategy
- Positioning as a public media / radio station serving the San Francisco Bay Area (91.7 FM)
- Tagline lockup: "91.7 FM Bay Area"
- Brand personality: bold, confident, vibrant, playful, energetic
- Guidelines emphasize consistency and "unforgettable and meaningful voice"
- Bauhaus-inspired visual identity with stencil typography roots

## Logo
- Custom KALW wordmark built on stencil Bauhaus typography principles
- Clean, minimal typographic approach with high contrast, geometric proportion
- Logo divided into eight vertical sections, inspiring an 8-column grid system
- Three scale variants: Large (full-width, hero), Medium (one column width), Small (partner lockups)
- Clearspace defined relative to the arm of the 'K' (half-height for large, full height for medium, stem width for small)
- Minimum size: 70px digital, 20mm print
- Simplified 'ka' icon for social media / favicons (pink on KALW Blue), circular and rounded-square variants
- Tagline lockup "91.7 FM Bay Area" for exceptional circumstances only
- 9 incorrect usage examples provided (no scaling, recoloring, reconstruction, photography fill, gradients, shadows, patterns)

## Typography
- **Primary Typeface:** ABC Favorit (by Dinamo) -- low-contrast grotesque with geometric rigidity and subtle oddities
- **Weights used:** Light (primary body/headlines), Light Italic, Medium (highlight/subheads), Medium Italic
- **Headline settings:** Leading 98%, Tracking -20, Word spacing 80-100-130%
- **Body copy settings:** Leading 115%, Tracking -20, Word spacing 80-100-130%
- **Character count:** 50-70 characters per line for body copy
- **Alignment:** Always ragged right / left-aligned; never centered or justified
- **Case:** Sentence case with punctuation throughout
- **System font replacement:** Mentioned (page 24) for fallback scenarios
- **Secondary display type:** KALW Stencil -- custom stencil letterforms used for expressive pattern generation and display headlines
- Alternate/expressive character forms in Favorit are explicitly prohibited

## Color Palette
- **Primary:** KALW Blue -- RGB 68/76/255, Hex #444CFF, Pantone 2726C / 2728U, CMYK 73/71/0/0 (a vivid electric blue)
- **Core palette (12 colors):**
  - Red: #FF2D67 / Pantone 192C
  - Purple: #9E11FF / Pantone 2592C
  - Yellow: #FFC100 / Pantone 7548C
  - Green: #028D57 / Pantone 7732C
  - Cyan: #2DD2FF / Pantone 310C
  - Peach: #FFAE92 / Pantone 475C
  - Pink: #FF65E7 / Pantone 231C
  - Lemon: #FFE400 / Pantone 102C
  - Lime: #9FF62F / Pantone 375C
  - White, Black
- **Color pairings system:** Four categories -- White+Dark, Black+Light, Tone-on-Tone, Complementary
- Full RGB, Hex, CMYK, and Pantone (coated + uncoated) values provided
- WCAG AA accessibility considered for digital color choices

## Graphic Elements
- **Pattern system:** Linework expanded from outlined KALW Stencil letterforms
- 26 pattern templates (one per letter of the alphabet)
- Letters with ascenders placed at bottom; descenders at top
- Patterns can be set in white or color against tone-on-tone / complementary backgrounds
- Four pattern-on-color modes: white on color, color on color, color on white, white on black
- Extensive incorrect usage guidance (9 items: no varied stroke, no fills, no multi-color, no dots, no hard angles, no shadows, no busy compositions, no minimal curves, no low contrast)
- Curved corners used as a signature shape element (1-3 corners, never all 4 or 0)

## Photography
- Style: raw, honest, naive -- not commercial, effortful, or slick
- Subject should evoke thinking or emotional response
- Verticals: Current Events, Sports, History, Travel, Nature, Science & Technology
- Framing: always at least one curved corner (max three), matching brand's curved corner motif
- Corner radius: no more than 1/4 of image width
- Margins match logo clearspace rules

## Applications
- Social media, Out of Home campaigns, Website, Banner ads, Welcome email
- Business cards, Program schedules, Monthly listings, Interview templates
- KALW Merch, Mural, Stage backdrop
- Layout overview with complexity scale: Simple (logo+text) to Complex (logo+text+pattern+photography)
- 8-column grid system derived from the logo's structure
- Large logo placement rules for portrait, narrow portrait, square, and landscape formats

## Tone of Voice
- Not extensively detailed in the visual guidelines
- Copy guidance focuses on typographic formatting (sentence case, ragged right, character count)
- Brand name always set in uppercase ("KALW") when used in copy

## Outliers & Unique Elements
- The 8-column grid derived directly from the logo's construction is a distinctive structural device
- KALW Stencil as a generative pattern system (each letter = a unique pattern template) is highly original
- Extremely comprehensive for a public radio station -- rivals commercial brand guidelines in depth
- Landscape-format presentation (1920x1080) designed for screen viewing
- 101 pages is exceptionally thorough

## Quality Score
4 / 5
Comprehensive, well-structured, and detailed. Covers all major brand touchpoints with clear rules, extensive incorrect-usage examples, and a distinctive pattern system. Loses a point for limited tone-of-voice guidance and no explicit brand strategy / mission / values section.
